scope: All existing 2010-2021 roster contests; filter through the independent Census city crosswalk for top-100 coverage.
limitations: Only records with verified_decisive status contain a verified final candidate pair. Other records retain unresolved statuses.
Inherited verified stages often cite Ballotpedia. They are not official-result verification.
An absent city-year does not prove that no mayoral election occurred.
The audit does not infer winners, runners-up, or decisive stages from roster vote totals.
Baltimore 2011 has inconsistent published totals and remains unresolved.

source_conflicts.note: State Archives lists Rawlings-Blake 39,548 and Griffin 6,022. Roster lists 37,970 and 5,826. Obtain certified final returns before promotion.
